title: HEA sections (EN 10365)
description: European wide flange beams HEA 100 to HEA 600: dimensions h, b, tw, tf, r and properties A, Iy, Wel_y, Wpl_y, i_y, Iz, Wel_z, Wpl_z, i_z and mass G, with units. Properties computed from the EN 10365 dimensions, including root fillets; within 0.2% of manufacturers' tables. Example: HEA("HEA 300", "Wpl_y").
author: AlirezaKORD
